'''Tayand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] crimelord who operated from a [[Tayand's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cilare]]. [[Connor Freeman]] bet his inheritance in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] against him and won, but Tayand, unwilling to accept defeat, claimed Freeman cheated and sent his men after Freeman, who escaped, but without his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Credits]], which prompted Tayand to place a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Freeman, who hurt his pride and was a threat to his reputation. One of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who took up the assignment was [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], but when he learned the truth, Fett turned in Freeman only to free him, shooting Tayand in the head due to a bounty placed on him by Freeman on the spot for three credits when he became uncooperative and refused Fett's offer to pay the money Freeman 'owed' Tayand in exchange for Freeman's freedom.
